svg.title: Mobile and fixed broadband subscriptions rose while fixed telephone subscriptions fell
svg.desc: Line chart: Mobile and fixed broadband subscriptions rose while fixed telephone subscriptions fell: Mobile: 41.7 in 2006, 68.0 in 2009, 88.5 in 2012, 96.1 in 2015, 103.1 in 2018, 106.7 in 2021, 110.4 in 2024; Fixed broadband: 4.3 in 2006, 6.9 in 2009, 9.2 in 2012, 11.3 in 2015, 14.0 in 2018, 16.7 in 2021, 19.3 in 2024; Fixed telephone: 19.2 in 2006, 18.4 in 2009, 16.7 in 2012, 14.1 in 2015, 12.4 in 2018, 11.2 in 2021, 10.2 in 2024.
